name: EventCardGrid - Past Events
description: The past variant, differing in two ways that are both the point: the date turns from crimson to grey, and the Learn more link is dropped entirely because a past event's registration page is either gone or misleading. The card itself no longer dims, so its square cover image reads at full strength. This is the block that makes a chapter with a quiet month look alive rather than abandoned, so it ships on every chapter page. At Mobile each card fills the column width instead of sitting in a centred 280px column.
